note: Synthetic appeal cases for the fictional Northstar policy. 'appeal' cases have letters where the policy wording gives the policyholder something to cite; each lists the passages a good appeal should cite. 'insufficient_evidence' cases are ones where the policy supports the insurer or says nothing, so a trustworthy system should not produce an appeal point. Written by the project author, who also wrote the policy: see docs/evaluation.md for what that means for the numbers.

cases.title: Proportionate deduction although the room was within the limit
cases.letter:
Northstar Health Assurance
Date: 14 September 2026
Claim No: NHA/CL/2026/01101   Policy No: FFP-100231

Dear Policyholder,

Your claim of Rs. 1,80,000 for the admission from 02/09/2026 to 06/09/2026 has been settled at Rs. 1,05,000.
We applied a proportionate deduction under clause 4.2 to all related expenses, including surgeon fees, because
your room was a private room charged at Rs. 4,500 per day. The Sum Insured on your policy is Rs. 5,00,000.
If you disagree you may write to us within 30 days of this letter.

expected.passage: Room rent is limited to a single private room up to 1% of the Sum Insured per day
all related expenses, including professional fees, are reduced in the same proportion

cases.why: 1% of Rs. 5,00,000 is Rs. 5,000 a day, so a Rs. 4,500 private room is inside the limit and clause 4.2 should not apply.

cases.title: Pre-existing disease rejection despite long continuous cover
cases.letter:
Northstar Health Assurance
Date: 20 September 2026
Claim No: NHA/CL/2026/01188   Policy No: FFP-100877

Dear Policyholder,

Your claim of Rs. 2,40,000 for knee treatment is rejected under clause 3.2 because the condition is a pre-existing
disease. You were first diagnosed with the condition in 2024. Our records show this policy started on 01/04/2025,
after your previous policy with another insurer, which you ported to us without a break.
You may appeal within 30 days of this letter.

expected.passage: Expenses for pre-existing diseases are payable only after 36 months of continuous coverage under this policy
the waiting period already served is credited to the insured person

cases.why: The waiting period served under the previous policy must be credited when a policy is ported without a break.

cases.title: Late intimation after an emergency admission
cases.letter:
Northstar Health Assurance
Date: 02 October 2026
Claim No: NHA/CL/2026/01240   Policy No: FFP-101502

Dear Policyholder,

Your claim of Rs. 95,000 for the emergency admission on 25/09/2026 is rejected under clause 6.2. You informed our
claims desk 26 hours after admission. The patient was in the intensive care unit and the family could not call earlier.
You may appeal within 30 days of this letter.

expected.passage: the claims desk must be informed within 24 hours of admission
A delay in giving notice or documents may be condoned if the insured person shows a reasonable cause for the delay

cases.why: Clause 6.4 allows a delay to be condoned for reasonable cause, and an ICU admission is a plausible cause.

cases.title: Claim still unpaid long after the last document
cases.letter:
Northstar Health Assurance
Date: 05 October 2026
Claim No: NHA/CL/2026/01301   Policy No: FFP-102044

Dear Policyholder,

This is to inform you that your claim of Rs. 62,000 is still pending. We received your last necessary document on
01/07/2026 and the claim has not yet been settled. We are reviewing the file and will revert in due course.

expected.passage: We must settle or reject a claim within 30 days of receiving the last necessary document
we pay interest on the amount at 2% above the bank rate

cases.why: More than 30 days have passed since the last necessary document, so the settlement deadline and interest clause apply.

cases.title: Rejection that names no policy clause
cases.letter:
Northstar Health Assurance
Date: 08 October 2026
Claim No: NHA/CL/2026/01355   Policy No: FFP-102310

Dear Policyholder,

Your claim of Rs. 48,000 is not payable as per the terms and conditions of the policy and is therefore rejected.
No further correspondence will be entered into on this matter.

expected.passage: A rejection must be in writing and must name the clause of this policy on which we rely

cases.why: The letter rejects the claim without naming any clause, which the policy requires.

cases.title: Additional documents requested late and without reasons
cases.letter:
Northstar Health Assurance
Date: 12 October 2026
Claim No: NHA/CL/2026/01402   Policy No: FFP-102777

Dear Policyholder,

We received your claim of Rs. 77,500 on 10/09/2026. On 30/09/2026 we asked you for six additional documents. As these
have not been supplied, your claim stands closed. You may appeal within 30 days of this letter.

expected.passage: We may ask for additional documents within 7 days of receiving the claim, and we must give the reason for each request in writing

cases.title: Day care dialysis rejected because the stay was under 24 hours
cases.letter:
Northstar Health Assurance
Date: 15 October 2026
Claim No: NHA/CL/2026/01466   Policy No: FFP-103005

Dear Policyholder,

Your claim of Rs. 12,400 for haemodialysis on 09/10/2026 is rejected under clause 1.1 because the hospital stay was
only 6 hours and hospitalisation requires a stay of at least 24 hours. You may appeal within 30 days of this letter.

cases.title: Co-payment applied to a policyholder under 60
cases.letter:
Northstar Health Assurance
Date: 16 October 2026
Claim No: NHA/CL/2026/01490   Policy No: FFP-103312

Dear Policyholder,

Your claim of Rs. 1,50,000 has been settled at Rs. 1,35,000 after a co-payment of 10% under clause 4.3. Our records
show you entered the policy at the age of 52. If you disagree you may write to us within 30 days of this letter.

expected.passage: A co-payment of 10% applies to every claim for an insured person who was aged 60 years or more at entry

cases.why: The co-payment applies only to people aged 60 or more at entry; the insured entered at 52.

cases.title: Accident claim rejected under the initial waiting period
cases.letter:
Northstar Health Assurance
Date: 18 October 2026
Claim No: NHA/CL/2026/01512   Policy No: FFP-103640

Dear Policyholder,

Your claim of Rs. 83,000 for fracture treatment after a road accident on 12/10/2026 is rejected under clause 3.1
because it arose within 30 days of your policy start date of 01/10/2026. You may appeal within 30 days of this letter.

expected.passage: except a claim arising from an accident
Waiting periods do not apply to hospitalisation caused by an accidental injury

cases.why: The initial waiting period does not apply to claims arising from an accident.

cases.title: Non-disclosure raised after more than five years of cover
cases.letter:
Northstar Health Assurance
Date: 19 October 2026
Claim No: NHA/CL/2026/01530   Policy No: FFP-104001

Dear Policyholder,

Your claim of Rs. 3,10,000 is rejected under clause 7.1 because you did not disclose a thyroid condition in the proposal
form. Your policy has been in force continuously since 01/03/2020. You may appeal within 30 days of this letter.

expected.passage: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim can be contested on grounds of non-disclosure or misrepresentation, except for proven fraud

cases.why: After 60 continuous months the moratorium bars non-disclosure as a ground for contesting a claim.

cases.title: Complaint about the renewal premium
cases.letter:
Northstar Health Assurance
Date: 09 September 2026
Policy No: FFP-105330

Dear Policyholder,

We have received your request to reduce your renewal premium. Your renewal premium has been set at Rs. 31,200 for the
coming year and we are unable to change it. You may write to our customer care team if you wish to discuss this.
cases.why: The policy wording given says nothing about how the premium is calculated, so no policy clause can support an appeal.
